reviewedBy: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (the worker for the third acceptance fix pass, self-review; not a cold reviewer)
method: Walked the changed screens in the worker's own captures (Home, Albums, album report, day 3 and day 7 recaps, Data) as visitor and owner, in Chromium and WebKit, at default, 200% and 312% text, contrast-more and forced-colors, on a local development server reading production data. Checked the rendered words of all 13 surfaces for both roles against the internal terms this pass removed (collector, linked-journey, denominator, backfill, Grid showings, src=, Downloads, week): 0 hits in 52 loads, and a planted term fired the check. Checked that no ISO date remains in the Data page's words. Found with the new navigation gate that a tabbed-to link at 312% text stayed partly under the fade, and fixed it. A late look at the album report found the comparison table's caption drawn twice, and removed one. Findings text on Home and the album report was seen from a read-only dry run of the next scheduled refresh, because the stored snapshot only changes when the job writes a new one. Not covered: a cold reviewer, a real device or an accessibility text size on iOS, a real sign-in, screen readers, real Cloudflare and PostHog panels, the Playwright specs.
scope: Album report order and merged findings
Home verdict, notes inside cards, unsorted share
